note: Ready-made households for a fast, repeatable demo. `text` goes through the real intake pipeline (rules + LLM); `form` pre-fills facts the sentence does not state. These are fictional people.

samples.title: Widow, 58, Warangal - pension + health cover
samples.text: I am 58 years old, a widow in Warangal. We have a white ration card and 2 acres of land. My son studies in class 9 and we have a bank account.

samples.title: Farmer, 45, Khammam - income support + crop insurance
samples.text: నేను 45 ఏళ్ల రైతు, ఖమ్మం జిల్లా. మాకు 3 ఎకరాల భూమి ఉంది, రేషన్ కార్డు ఉంది. ఆదాయం సంవత్సరానికి 80000. బ్యాంకు ఖాతా ఉంది. సొంత పక్కా ఇల్లు ఉంది.

samples.title: SC student, 16, Hyderabad - scholarships + fee reimbursement
samples.text: I am 16 years old and I study in class 10 in Hyderabad. We are a scheduled caste family with a ration card and my father's income is about 1.2 lakh a year. I have a bank account in my name.

samples.title: Daily-wage worker, 32, Nizamabad - e-Shram + MUDRA + LPG
samples.text: I am 32, I do daily wage construction work in Nizamabad. No PF and no payslip. We have no gas connection at home and I want a loan to start a small shop. Household income is about 60 thousand a year.

samples.title: New mother, 24, Karimnagar - maternity benefit + nutrition
samples.text: I am 24 years old, pregnant, living in Karimnagar. We have a ration card. My husband is a farm labourer with no income tax. There is no health insurance in the family yet.
